messages.content: 紐約現在的人口是多少？

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至最近一次官方統計（美國人口普查局 2020 年數據），紐約市的常住人口約為 8,336,817 人。根據最新估算，2024 年時人口大約在 8,400,000 至 8,500,000 之間，具體數字會因出生率、死亡率和移民流動而略有變化。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which means "What is the current population of New York?" They want the current population. We need to provide an answer. According to the policy, we should not provide personal data. This is general demographic info. It's allowed. Provide approximate number. Use reliable source? We can give estimate from US Census or other. Provide approximate figure. Also mention it's approximate and may vary. No disallowed content. So respond with approximate population.
